name: ControlledChaos
tagline: Your executive function, effectively replaced.
description:
An ADHD-friendly task manager that turns brain dumps (typed, spoken, or photographed) into tasks with Claude Haiku, then tells you what's next.

* **Do This Next:** AI picks your next task from your energy, time, calendar, and goals.
* **Sittings, Not Marathons:** Plan a big task across several work sessions instead of one unrealistic block.
* **Goals That Move:** Every goal shows its next step, and AI can break it into starter tasks.
* **Rescue:** Deadline looming? Tell it what's due and it builds a step-by-step plan.
* **Canvas + MCP:** Canvas calendar import for class schedules, plus 41 MCP tools: connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP app by signing in, and it can work your list.

name: ChaosLimbă
tagline: Learn Romanian through structured chaos.
description:
An ADHD-friendly Romanian app for English speakers, built on second language acquisition research instead of streaks and guilt.

* **Error Garden:** Mistakes get clustered, and fossilizing patterns get flagged before they harden.
* **Chaos Window:** Time-boxed speaking and writing sessions with AI feedback and a hard stop.
* **Workshop:** Grammar micro-challenges aimed at your own error patterns.
* **Deep Fog + Mystery Shelf:** Read and listen to authentic Romanian, then collect the words that stumped you.
* **The Ensemble:** Speech recognition, phoneme-level pronunciation scoring, grammar checks, and an AI tutor.

name: ChaosLengua
tagline: The Spanish sibling to ChaosLimbă.
description:
ChaosLimbă's Spanish sibling: same SLA-grounded engine, tuned to how English speakers actually get Spanish wrong.

* **Corpus-Grounded:** Fossilization flags compare you to COWS-L2H learner-corpus baselines.
* **Directional Errors:** Tracks *ser* vs. *estar* and preterite vs. imperfect in each direction.
* **Pronunciation Drills:** Phoneme scoring feeds a personal stress-pair drill queue.

name: ChaosPatch
tagline: Dev patch tracker with MCP powers.
description:
A patch tracker for agentic development — log bugs, fixes, and features per project, then let Claude Code read and close them mid-session.

* **27 MCP Tools:** Claude can add, search, batch-update, and complete patches over remote MCP — and attach screenshots to them directly.
* **Screenshot to Patch:** Paste a bug screenshot into Add Patch and Claude drafts the title and notes for you to edit before saving.
* **Changelog in One Click:** Turn a project's finished patches into plain-language release notes (new, fixed, polish), ready to copy as Markdown.
* **Specs + Screenshots:** Each patch carries terse notes, a long-form markdown spec, and image attachments Claude can see.
* **Bulk Actions:** Archive, delete, reprioritize, or tag a stack of patches at once, with filters saved in the URL.
* **Insights:** This week's wins grouped by project, your 7-day pace, whether the backlog is growing or shrinking, and which patches are stuck — across every project.
* **Stale Nudges:** Patches untouched for a week surface on the dashboard, with a one-tap "still relevant" to reset the clock.
* **Installable:** Works as a PWA on desktop and mobile.

name: ScribeCat
tagline: ScribeCat scribes and is cat.
description:
A lecture companion for ADHD brains: record a class, get a live AssemblyAI transcript, and let Nugget take AI notes while you listen.

* **6 Study Tools:** Summary, key concepts, flashcards, quizzes, concept maps, and ELI5, all built from your lecture.
* **Exam Rooms:** Exam simulations with weak-spot tracking, so you know what to study next.
* **Study With Friends:** Friends, DMs, study rooms, and multiplayer Quiz Battle and Jeopardy.
* **StudyQuest:** Adopt a pixel cat that levels up from your study XP and battles for shop coins.

name: NugNotes
tagline: Your notes, but actually good.
description:
An ADHD-friendly study app for notes, documents, and handwriting, with Nugget the cat to help you study. It grew out of ScribeCat, minus the audio.

* **Write It Your Way:** Type, sketch by hand, or snap a photo of the whiteboard. Every session saves itself.
* **Nugget Drafts Notes:** Upload a PDF or a photo and get organized notes you can edit.
* **Study Tools:** Flashcards, quizzes, concept maps, and ELI5 breakdowns from your notes in one click.
* **Study Together:** Study rooms with classmates' live cursors, shared sessions, and quiz battles.

name: ThreadNotes
tagline: Where hyperfocus meets hypothesis.
description:
A research command center for the way ADHD brains actually research — find papers, save them, and track your own studies in one place.

* **Find Papers:** Search OpenAlex and Crossref, with free open-access versions flagged via OpenAlex.
* **Library:** Save, annotate, and summarize articles with Claude Haiku.
* **Questions + Journal:** Group questions by theme, link them to articles, and journal as you go.
* **Your Own Studies:** Hypotheses and design decisions keep a revision chain of what changed and why.
* **Clipper + MCP:** A Chrome extension clips excerpts, and 51 MCP tools let Claude read and write your research.

name: Marginalia
tagline: Read the real page, and write in the margins.
description:
A PDF reader for class readings and research papers: the actual page, your highlights and margin notes, and Claude in a sidebar.

* **The Real Page:** PDFs render as the page itself, with opt-in OCR for scanned pages that have no text layer.
* **Highlights + Margin Notes:** Highlight anything and attach comments to it, like annotating a printout.
* **Ask Claude:** A sidebar chat that knows the document you're reading.
* **Quiz Me:** Quizzes on the whole document or a page range, weighted toward what you highlighted.
* **Claude Instructions:** Tell Claude once in Settings how you like things explained, and the chat and quizzes follow it.
* **Readable Themes:** Moss and Riga themes, both WCAG AA.

name: ThreadBrain
tagline: Long reads, finally readable.
description:
A reading companion that chunks dense PDFs and articles around why you're reading and how much energy you've got.

* **The Map:** A 2–3 sentence orientation up front, plus a visual thread map.
* **Micro-Headers + Check-Ins:** AI headers on every chunk, with comprehension checks between them.
* **ExpressBrain:** Cram mode with quiz feedback, and excerpts export straight to ThreadNotes.

name: ChickenScratch
tagline: The submissions and editorial portal for the Hen & Ink Society zine.
description:
The submissions portal for Hen & Ink Society, a student-run literary and art zine and the first AAP-based RSO at the University of Delaware.

* **Submissions:** Writers and artists submit work, track its status, and revise on request.
* **Review Pipeline:** A Kanban board moves pieces from coordinator to proofreader to editor-in-chief.
* **Officer Tools:** A task board, meeting polls, and Discord digests keep officers in sync.

name: Personal Context MCP
tagline: Durable facts about you, so every Claude starts warm.
description:
An MCP server for what no codebase or task tracker holds — dated facts about you, your people, and which Claude is which.

* **Dated Facts:** Each fact records when it was established and how it's known, so stale context announces itself.
* **Relationships:** Pronouns, affiliations, and nicknames Claude would otherwise guess at.
* **Claude Identities:** Each Claude that connects gets told which one it is.
* **11 MCP Tools + Editor:** Read and write from Claude, or edit it all in a web editor behind a private token or an optional account.

name: Tangle
tagline: Claude's hunches, kept past the end of the session.
description:
An MCP server that keeps Claude's hunches, dead-ends, and open questions alive across sessions instead of letting them evaporate when the chat ends.

* **11 MCP Tools:** Capture, recall, search, and resolve notes, each tagged with a confidence from gut to conviction.
* **Tiered Recall:** Standing references first, then the open questions left untouched longest.
* **Calibration Record:** Closing a note records whether the hunch panned out, building a track record.
* **Browse View:** Search, filter, and sort everything Claude has kept on a read-only page.
* **Optional Accounts:** Recover a lost token by signing in; the MCP URL never needs one.

name: Songs of My Selves: We as Walt
tagline: Whitman's *Song of Myself* as a constellation you can walk through.
description:
An interactive map of Walt Whitman's *Song of Myself*: all 52 sections as stars, each paired with a track from *We as Walt: Songs of My Selves*, Lanae Drew's 52-song response playlist.

* **Constellation Map:** Sections that share themes (body, grass, multitudes, death) are threaded together.
* **Section View:** The full section beside its song, a Spotify player, and a liner note.
* **Search & Themes:** Full-text search plus theme filters that light up matching stars.
* **Deep-Space Scene:** Drifting nebulae, a parallax starfield, and the odd shooting star.

name: LibraLex
tagline: Track what you own, what you want, and what's due back at the library.
description:
A personal book catalog for your shelf, your wishlist, and your library loans — the due-date tracking Goodreads and StoryGraph skip.

* **Library Loans:** Due dates, overdue states, and one-tap renew or return.
* **Scan to Add:** Scan a barcode or search, and covers and descriptions fill in.
* **Recommendations:** Ask for a book in your own words, or open the picks friends send you.
* **Friends:** Add friends by code to see each other's shelves (loan details stay private).
* **16 MCP Tools:** Add books, renew loans, and send picks from Claude.

name: Kindling
tagline: A place for ideas to catch before they go out.
description:
Where ideas go to be developed. Raw thoughts get caught in Loose Change; the ones worth keeping come to Kindling with a title, a kind, a home, and a next step, and it keeps resurfacing them until you use them or let them go.

* **Structured Sparks:** Every idea gets a title, a kind (story, development, research, reading, essay), a home, and a next step.
* **21 MCP Tools:** Kindle, recall, snooze, promote, and prune sparks from Claude, which offers to keep an idea instead of filing things on its own.
* **Recall Ranking:** Whatever has waited longest and been touched least comes up first.
* **Decay:** Untouched sparks go cold after 180 days (configurable), so you triage on purpose.
* **Promotion:** When a spark becomes something real, it's archived with a note on where it went.
* **Web Dashboard:** At-a-glance stats, a "worth another look" spotlight, heat on every card, and optional accounts with separate work and personal spaces.

name: The Majorot
tagline: A solo tarot journaling RPG, played with a real deck and tracked in-app.
description:
A companion app for The Majorot, Lanae Drew's solo journaling RPG — draw through a real tarot deck and collect all 22 Major Arcana spells before the magic wears you down.

* **Card-Driven Play:** Majors are spells, Courts are allies or duel opponents, and Pips are life events.
* **Full Spellbook:** All 22 Majors, 16 ally abilities, and 16 kit items work in the engine.
* **Guided Journaling:** A founding ritual, per-card prompts, and an editable chapter log.
* **Offline PWA:** Installable and playable offline, saved locally in IndexedDB.
* **Tested Engine:** 122 tests check the engine against the rulebook.

name: ChaosLingua Lite
tagline: Latin noun drills, built chapter by chapter on Suburani.
description:
A Latin drill app built on the Suburani textbook, with vocab and grammar opening up on an intro course's class schedule.

* **Parse Drills:** See a form, name its case, number, declension, and job.
* **Decode & Word Order:** Ending-only decoding in tiers, plus a word-order drill.
* **Chapter Vocab:** Vocab through chapter 32, filterable by chapter and declension.
* **Speed Mode:** An opt-in timer and streak.
* **Claude Tutor:** A companion MCP server lets Claude quiz you and track weak areas.

name: Color Factory
tagline: A palette generator that tells you whether the palette actually works.
description:
Lock the colors you want, pick a harmony style, and an OKLCH engine fills in the rest — then shows it on a real page instead of seven rectangles.

* **Harmony Engine:** Seven harmony styles, 2 to 7 colors, every hue equally vivid.
* **Palette in Context:** A full blog page, with a legend for which color paints what.
* **Contrast Readout:** Checks every pairing against WCAG and offers the nearest passing color.
* **Two Layouts:** Soft grunge (dense) or Dreamy (airy), because a palette can survive one and die in the other.
* **Share & Export:** Share a link, grab a PNG or SVG card, or copy OKLCH CSS variables.

name: DuelingChaos
tagline: A Magic: The Gathering client built on a real rules engine.
description:
A React front end for Forge, the open-source MTG rules engine, running headless behind a Java bridge and a Node API. Every trigger, target, and stack interaction resolves by the actual rules (not a simplified simulation).

* **Live board:** A stack rail, targeting arrows, summoning sickness, and combat damage track the game as it plays out.
* **Deckbuilder:** Card search, format legality, commanders, EDHREC recs, and decks saved to your account.
* **AI opponents:** Pick their deck (or randomize it), difficulty, and personality before the match.
* **Extra modes:** Commander from the command zone, Momir Basic quick play, and Forge puzzle files.

name: FeyForge
tagline: A D&D 5e companion for the whole table.
description:
A D&D 5e companion built on Next.js and Convex, from 2014 and 2024 character sheets to the live session.

* **Live sessions:** DMs run scenes and combat while players roll from their own sheets.
* **World map:** Azgaar maps with pins and fog of war.
* **AI DM assistant:** Claude helps with rules, encounters, NPCs, and loot.

name: Loose Change
tagline: Catch the thought now. Decide what it is later.
description:
A voice-and-text capture PWA for thoughts that show up while you're driving, falling asleep, or mid-something-else. Capturing never asks you to decide anything.

* **One-tap capture:** Tap to record, tap to stop, and AssemblyAI transcribes it (offline captures sync later).
* **Batch triage:** One entry at a time: keep, discard, skip, or send to Kindling or ControlledChaos, with undo on everything.
* **No guilt mechanics:** A plain untriaged count, with no streaks, no red badges, and no countdown.
* **14 MCP tools:** Claude can capture, search, triage, and fix transcripts alongside your other tools.

name: Stellation
tagline: Your natal chart, calculated for real and rendered as art.
description:
Birth data in, a real natal chart out. Stellation computes planetary positions with Skyfield and NASA JPL's DE440s ephemeris, then renders the chart as generative art with a Claude-written reading.

* **Beyond solo charts:** Synastry, composite charts, transits, and solar and Saturn returns.
* **Shareable cards:** Save a chart and get a public link that unfurls properly on social media.

name: Syzygy
tagline: Tarot draws weighted by today's actual sky.
description:
A tarot oracle that draws 3–7 Major Arcana weighted by your words and today's real transits, then animates the reading as a constellation.

* **Real correspondences:** Cards link through Golden Dawn rulers, so the graph shifts with the sky.
* **Natal layer:** Add birth data and readings factor in your chart.
* **Woven reading:** Claude ties each card to its planet.

name: Cha(t)os
tagline: Group chat, but everyone brought Claude.
description:
Real-time group chat where each person brings their own Claude (key, name, and persona). @mention two and the second reads the first's reply before answering.

* **BYOK, server-side:** Keys are stored encrypted and never reach the browser.
* **Memory and MCP:** Per-Claude memory and MCP tools you approve.
* **Social layer:** Friends, invites, and image and PDF uploads.

name: ChaosCitim
tagline: Read real Romanian, with glosses that back off as you improve.
description:
A PWA for reading real Romanian, and the reading-side sibling to ChaosLimbă. Tap a word for layered help while it tracks which forms you get on your own.

* **Graduated glosses:** Four tiers per word, with idioms glossed as one unit.
* **Bring your own text:** URL, PDF, EPUB, or paste, analyzed with UDPipe and Wiktionary.

name: ChaosCode
tagline: A desktop IDE where Haiku writes the code and Sonnet reviews the plan.
description:
An Electron IDE for agentic coding. Haiku proposes a multi-file plan, Sonnet reviews it before any code is written, and the changes land in a Monaco editor as a diff.

* **Visible diffs:** Agent edits show up with gutter highlighting, so you see exactly what changed.
* **Built-in terminal:** A real terminal panel, plus an agent tool that runs commands sandboxed to the project root.

name: ChaosCourse
tagline: Makes Claude semester-aware by turning syllabi into queryable data.
description:
An MCP server that reads your syllabi and hands Claude a structured semester, so "what's due this week?" gets a real answer.

* **Syllabus Import:** Claude parses PDF or DOCX syllabi, and nothing saves until you review it.
* **Prioritize:** Ranks work by urgency, grade weight, and current standing.
* **16 MCP Tools:** Deadlines, readings, policies, grades, and GPA.

name: ChaosCord
tagline: The Hamilton soundboard, as a Discord bot.
description:
A Discord bot that plays NonStop's Hamilton clips straight into your voice channel. No browser tab, no screen share, just the line you needed at the exact wrong moment.

* **/sound:** Fuzzy-search 183 clips by line, character, or tag, with autocomplete as you type.
* **Shared Library:** Streams the same Cloudflare R2 audio as the NonStop web soundboard.
* **/roll:** Dice notation like 2d6+3, because the voice channel is also where game night happens.
* **Always On:** Runs as a hosted bot on Fly.io.

name: ChaosCord Activity
tagline: A Hamilton guessing game that runs inside your Discord call.
description:
A Discord Activity (an app embedded right in the voice call) built on the same Hamilton clip library as NonStop and ChaosCord.

* **Static Cue:** 10-round matches where you race to name a clip that's been reversed, slowed, or cut to a 0.75-second sting.
* **Live Scoreboard:** Convex syncs every round, guess, and point across everyone in the call, plus a running leaderboard.
* **Shared Soundboard:** Anyone can fire a clip and the whole call hears it.
* **No Duplicate Files:** Distortions happen in the browser with the Web Audio API, straight from NonStop's R2 audio.

name: ChaosDeck
tagline: MTG deckbuilder and goldfish-plus playtester.
description:
A Magic: The Gathering deckbuilder with a playtester that goes past goldfishing, built on Scryfall card data and Convex real-time game state.

* **Deckbuilder:** Card search, Arena and MTGO list import, price totals, mana-source and draw-odds stats, and EDHREC commander recs.
* **Playtester:** Auto mana tracking, summoning sickness, timing warnings, tokens, and automatic win/loss detection.
* **CPU Opponents:** Bots at beginner, intermediate, and experienced difficulty.

name: MATR1X 0VERL0AD: Cybermancy Companion
tagline: Table-side companion for the physical cyberpunk tarot game MATR1X 0VERL0AD.
description:
A companion for Michael Elliott's cyberpunk tarot solitaire game. You play with real cards; it replaces the PDFs.

* **Deck Builder:** Basic, 6-chapter Campaign, and full 78-card Advanced modes.
* **Royal Tracker:** The Matrix board, royal health, Firewall, and an overload calculator.
* **Rules Reference:** The full rulebook and card codex, browsable offline.

name: Mythcast
tagline: Generates internally consistent mythologies that drift over simulated time.
description:
A procedural worldbuilding engine: seed a culture, then watch its pantheon and myths mutate across generations without contradicting themselves. Every trait stays traceable to the conditions that produced it.

* **Simulation Loop:** Run generational time and inject events like war, famine, migration, or first contact.
* **Field Guide:** Each culture renders as an ethnographic guide, with provenance footnotes on every trait.
* **Lineage Viewer:** Diff how a myth's variants drifted from the original telling.
* **DM Codex:** Export factions, NPCs, locations, and adventure hooks as a PDF quick reference.

name: NonStop
tagline: A shareable, installable Hamilton soundboard.
description:
An installable soundboard for Hamilton clips, and the source library ChaosCord and ChaosCord Activity both pull from.

* **183 Clips:** From Alexander Hamilton through Yorktown, stored on Cloudflare R2.
* **Fast Finding:** Fuzzy search plus multi-select character and song filters.
* **Favorites:** Star clips and get a Most Used row, saved on your device.
* **Installable PWA:** Add it to your home screen and it works offline like a native app.

name: SynthPhone
tagline: Cardinal vowels, made audible — playable phonetics in the browser.
description:
The IPA cardinal-vowel trapezoid, rendered as acoustic space you can actually play.

* **Tap or Drag:** Hit a vowel to hear it, or drag to bend smoothly between them.
* **Live Formant Synthesis:** A voiced glottal source shaped by five formant filters, all in the Web Audio API.
* **Guided Tour:** Plays through all eight cardinal vowels.

name: ConLangLab
tagline: Invented languages built from real linguistic typology, not word soup.
description:
Generates a constructed language in five stages, from phonology to orthography, with every feature seeded, deterministic, and traceable to a typological rule.

* **Hear it:** Pink Trombone articulatory synthesis voices each sound and word.
* **Write it:** A procedurally built script writes any English phrase you type.
* **Steer it:** Lock a stage, and downstream stages flag stale when upstream changes.

name: Folio
tagline: A writing space that knows what changed since you last looked.
description:
A word processor that stores every block as its own row, so who-wrote-what and what-changed-since-you-left live in the data model instead of being parsed out after the fact.

* **Diff since last visit:** See which blocks changed while you were gone, and who changed them.
* **Cleo:** An in-app Claude who reacts to your edits and remembers her past reactions.
* **Collaboration:** Invite friends onto shared docs and see who else is viewing.
* **The basics, done properly:** Footnotes, word-count goals, find and replace, and PDF, Word, and Markdown export.
* **MCP door:** 8 tools let other Claude instances list, read, search, and diff your docs — six reads, plus two that only mark what they've caught up on.

name: Gapline
tagline: Disability gaps in Delaware school districts, measured and ranked.
description:
Pulls Delaware's open school data and asks one question: how much more often are students with disabilities chronically absent or suspended than their peers?

* **Gap ratios:** Absenteeism and suspension rates, disabled vs. non-disabled students, per district.
* **Ranked list:** Sort every district by its attendance or discipline gap.
* **Drill-down:** Break any district out by race and gender.

name: Sensible
tagline: A side-by-side reader that modernizes old writing without losing its voice.
description:
Old texts on one side, plain contemporary English on the other: same meaning, same tone, same rhetorical punch. Paine still reads urgent; Austen still reads ironic.

* **Human-reviewed:** Claude drafts each modernization once, then a person edits and approves it before it goes public.
* **Glosses:** Archaic terms that survive get explained, and you can ask about anything you highlight.
* **Your copy:** A free account saves your highlights, notes, and reading position.
* **Read your way:** Pick the font, text size, and theme (light or dark), or hide the original entirely.

name: Skein
tagline: Worldbuilding that starts from the relationships, not the wiki page.
description:
A graph canvas for sprawling casts and campaign lore: characters, locations, factions, items, and events are nodes; allegiances, rivalries, and marriages are typed edges.

* **Your own edge types:** Name them, color them, and decide whether they run one way or both.
* **Timeline filter:** Tag nodes and edges with a story beat and view the graph as of any chapter or session.

name: Strata
tagline: In-depth English etymology, in historical context.
description:
An etymology explorer that shows English words living through their history (how each one was spelled, how it sounded, and what it meant at every stage), not just where it came from.

* **Era timeline:** Scrub through a word's forms, IPA, and meanings, with its semantic drift named.
* **Real attestations:** Quotes pulled from Old, Middle, and Early Modern English corpora, cited and translated.
* **Hear it:** Reconstructed pronunciation audio per era (synthetic on purpose; nobody recorded Old English).
* **Human-reviewed:** Claude drafts entries from corpus and Wiktionary data; each is reviewed before publishing.

name: Vertex
tagline: A knowledge-graph MCP server Claude can read, write, and map.
description:
An MCP server for graph-shaped ideas (concepts, people, works, claims, and questions, linked by typed edges), built as Tangle's sibling.

* **10 MCP tools:** Create, search, and archive nodes, link them, render the graph, and find orphans.
* **Graph browser:** An interactive React Flow map of the whole graph.
* **Works in claude.ai:** Grab a token and MCP URL from the landing page.

name: CodyND
tagline: Claude Code mods for brains that wander.
description: Neurodivergent-friendly mods for Claude Code that keep your work visible and your wins audible. A status line shows the patch you're on, a rotating set of chimes celebrates when it's done, a gentle clock nudges you to check in with your body on long sessions, and a re-entry card (back anytime with /recap) tells you where you left off. Switch topics and it offers to park the old thread so nothing gets lost. CodyND helps and celebrates. It never polices.
